title: Implement Request Body Parsing
description: This feature is crucial for handling JSON and URL-encoded request bodies, enabling yantraverse to support a wider range of use cases and improving its overall usability. It will provide a built-in way to parse request bodies, reducing the need for external middleware. This will enhance the framework's stability and performance
testCases: Test error handling for invalid request bodies
acceptance: Request body parsing works correctly for JSON and URL-encoded formats, and error handling is implemented for invalid or malformed request bodies
reason: This feature is essential for a production-ready framework, as it directly impacts the ability to handle various types of requests and provides a more comprehensive set of tools for developers
